sloka: हत्वा तु पंच सहस्रान् अनयत् यम सदनम् ।दूषणम् निहतम् श्रुत्वा तस्य च एव पदानुगान् ॥३-२६-२३॥
transliteration: hatvā tu paṁca sahasrān anayat yama sadanam ।dūṣaṇam nihatam śrutvā tasya ca eva padānugān ॥3-26-23॥

translations.english: Seeing Dusana and his followers killed, enraged Khara commanded his extremely strong army chiefs this way:
